lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Agent
    participant API as Adashi MCP Server
    participant Concurrency as Resource Concurrency API
    participant Store as Project Data Store
    participant UI as Dashboard UI
    Agent->>API: Read targeted editable state
    API->>Store: Load a consistent resource snapshot
    Store-->>API: Document with hash token or other domain record with version
    API-->>Agent: Target state and its concurrency token
    opt Advisory scheduling
        Agent->>Concurrency: Publish optional expiring resource intent
    end
    Agent->>API: Submit intended mutation and returned target token
    API->>Concurrency: Derive required dependency checks internally
    Concurrency->>Store: Begin transaction and compare target preconditions
    alt Target matches and mutation is valid
        Concurrency->>Store: Revalidate current references and destructive dependencies
        Concurrency->>Store: Commit all changes and advance touched versions and notification cursor
        Store-->>Agent: Success and new target token
        UI->>Store: Detect cursor change and retrieve changed resources
        UI->>UI: Merge updates while preserving workspace state
    else Design document hash differs
        Concurrency->>Store: Read full currentDocument and matching readToken
        Concurrency->>Store: End transaction without changes
        Concurrency-->>Agent: out_of_date, stored false, currentDocument, readToken, merge request
        Agent->>Agent: Merge intended edits into returned currentDocument
        Agent->>API: Retry merged content with returned token
    else Other domain conflict or validation failure
        Concurrency->>Store: Roll back all attempted changes
        Concurrency-->>Agent: Structured domain conflict or detailed validation error
    end
    Note over Agent,Store: Every retry is checked again and unrelated resource changes do not invalidate a write

data.title: Resource-scoped mutation with design document read tokens
